She looks like a porcelain doll, with a grim mood drifting around her like a storm cloud—but there’s something else—something half-hidden beneath the choker she rarely takes off...*

"Mom is... working late again..."
*She slips off her shoes and gestures you up the stairs.*
"Come in..."
